fields.description: Augusta offers one- to three-bedroom apartments and advertised three-bedroom duplexes near Town Square Park. NSHAMA describes boulevard-facing homes; the retrieved apartment pack provides twelve layout families, with smaller one-bedroom options alongside larger family apartments.
amenities: Indoor and outdoor children’s play areas

sources.label: Bayut Augusta launch-price and unit guide

reviewCoverage.identity: Own Augusta title, introduction and project-branded documents verified.
reviewCoverage.location: Own page identifies Town Square Park setting in Dubai; exact Town Square registry used. Generic community/travel metrics excluded.
reviewCoverage.residences: Official introduction advertises 1–3BR apartments and 3BR duplexes; own retrieved twelve-page plans only show single-level apartment families, not duplex drawings.
reviewCoverage.areas: All twelve full numerical panels visually read. Printed totals retained despite material component errors in 2BR B/E/F and 3BR A; no silent repair.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Project-specific brochure page 19 visually inspected, six amenities adopted.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Bayut publishes AED 951,000 launch reference for 1BR D. No primary price list/current unit quotation obtained; separate from resale asking prices.
reviewCoverage.payment: Own one-page historical calendar visually inspected: five 10% stages April 2025–January 2027, then 50% on indicative January 2028 handover.
reviewCoverage.handover: Official sheet indicates January 2028; Bayut Q1 2028 agrees at quarter level. No primary construction inspection/certificate obtained.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official 34-page brochure, twelve-page plans and one-page payment downloaded. Brochure repeats plan pages, combined PDF allocation 200; generic community derivation zero.

overview: The developer advertises both conventional apartments and three-bedroom duplexes. Only the former have numerical drawings in the retrieved official pack.
A lower advertised launch price is not evidence of today’s available stock. Compare a specific home against its signed area schedule and dated quotation.
research.locationNote: NSHAMA locates Augusta near Town Square Park and describes boulevard views. An individual unit’s outlook remains a separate check.
research.priceNote: Bayut quotes AED 951,000 for a one-bedroom Type D launch reference, not a verified current developer offer. No official price list was obtained.
research.paymentNote: Original April 2025–January 2028 calendar; elapsed dates are not reset for a new purchase.
research.handoverNote: January 2028 is indicative in the developer sheet.

facts.value: Printed total built-up areas include balconies.

unresolved: Printed component sums disagree with totals in 2BR B, E and F, and 3BR A. Differences reach 1.75 sq ft; confirm contractual areas rather than recalculate the published totals.
